claims.statement: For every union of three distinct parallel affine cosets and the genuine-Boolean selector splice, the local coherent associator satisfies Omega <= 8 ln(2) I(d), uniformly in dimension, codimension, bias, physical orientation, and overlap; the constant is the sharp supremum.
Pathwise coordinate nonreuse alone would imply sum_v w_v I(d_v) <= I(b).
